meta.name: Euronews
meta.description:
Euronews is Europe’s leading international news channel. Its mission is to empower people to form their own opinion. Euronews is impartial with a diversity of viewpoints. It is “All Views”. It broadcasts 24/7 and boasts 12 language editions.

Shows: The European debrief, 5 Minutes, News, The Ring, Made In Europe
Available on: Tubi, The Roku Channel, Plex
